verdict.rationale: Twilio documents an Authy API with SDKs for common web languages, but its own docs page says the API is closed to new customers and will be fully deprecated, pointing new integrations to Verify v2 instead. A new AI-native user therefore cannot actually adopt it. Missing for 10: an API open to new users, a non-deprecated status, documented API coverage of the consumer authenticator app itself, and hands-on corroboration.
